title: stale-CSI premise test -- HONEST NEGATIVE under the real regime; premise confirmed (stale degrades the anchor); method does not repair it
source_commit_cited: 4357eb6 (R7); R6 96f35f7 (current-channel: no gate operating point beats the anchor); Q14 (stale drops the anchor)
decision: HONEST NEGATIVE under the real regime. Premise CONFIRMED (stale CSI significantly degrades the anchor: random -0.055 CI>0 / urban -0.165 CI>0). The evidence-gated action does NOT repair the drop at any tau_edit (no (gated - stale_anchor) feas CI lo>0); best point is the empty gate (== stale_anchor); firing edits net-negative + unsafe rises. The 'room' hypothesis is refuted. Completes the campaign -> R10 close-out.

stale_csi_overlay.effect: the DEPLOYED actor observes stale CSI cols 0-3 (frame t-1) + [age, mask] at DECISION time; the evaluator stays on the TRUE current channel (leak-free score)

heads_retrained_on_stale.note: heads see stale ef; labels from TRUE evaluator (training-only)

evidence_gate.effect_stale: == stale_anchor at tau 0.5 (urban edit 0); net-negative when firing

threshold_sweep.finding: no tau_edit gives (gated - stale_anchor) feas CI lo>0; downhill-from-empty-gate; firing net-negative in mean + unsafe rises. Same pattern as R6 current-channel, now in the STALE regime. 'Room' hypothesis refuted.

interpretation: Premise confirmed (stale CSI significantly degrades the anchor, CI>0 both regimes; urban -0.165 matches Q14 0.80->0.66). But the evidence-gated action does not repair the drop at any operating point (DEPLOYED A/B + sweep): the gate suppresses at tau 0.5 (== stale_anchor) or fires net-harmful edits at lower tau. R8 did NOT re-measure the stale-trained heads' held top-k precision; the no-repair is established from the deployed outcome and is consistent with an equal-or-lower precision than R5's ~40% current-channel figure (inferred, not measured). The stale-degraded anchor's 'room' does not rescue the method. The deployable direction-signal precision limit holds in BOTH the current-channel (R6/R7) and stale-channel (R8) regimes.
diagnosis_scope: DATA/precision limit under the STALE regime; NOT a leak/mechanism/trainer bug. Completes the campaign's central finding: no deployable arm beats the local_hysteresis anchor on either channel at N<=16.
effect_on_decision: gate changes topology when loosened (edit up to 0.038 urban / 0.027 random) but net-harmful; == stale_anchor at tau 0.5 (urban edit 0). Load-bearing; deployed effect null-or-negative vs stale anchor.

adversarial_verification.independent_checks: runtime: stale CSI cols diverge at t>=1 (max|diff|=1.0), ef dim +2 [age,mask]; evaluator byte-identical stale-vs-current over 32 topologies x every frame (leak-free); paired stale_drop (same seed hd_s vs hd_c); sweep programmatically confirmed NO tau has (gated-stale_anchor) feas CI lo>0; CI midpoints == means (t=2.776,n=5).
adversarial_verification.minor_fixes_applied: (1) qualified the '~40% precision (stale)' as INFERRED from the deployed no-repair, not re-measured (R8 measured the deployed outcome, not stale head top-k); (2) relabeled stale_csi_overlay status ACTIVE_IN_EVAL -> ACTIVE in the DEPLOYED decision observation.
